seo.metaTitle: About Centrifungal - UK Mushroom Grow Logs
seo.metaDescription: Learn about Centrifungal, a small UK-based mushroom grow log business dedicated to making home mushroom growing simple and accessible.

blocks.body: Welcome to Centrifungal. We are a small UK-based business passionate about making mushroom growing accessible to everyone. Whether you are a complete beginner or an experienced grower, our products are designed to make the process simple and rewarding.
